THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO:
 A. ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS AND DIRECT THE RESPONDENTS TO ISSUE FINAL NOTIFICATION AND PASS AN AWARD FORTHWITH AND PAY THE COMPENSATION TO THE PETITIONERS, IN PURSUANCE OF SEC 11(1) P1 HG NOTIFICATION ANNEXURE-A NO.VJIJA/BHUSWA-02/CR-19/2022-23 DATED 20.08.2022.
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:7695  WP No. 103145 of 2024  B. ISSUE

A WRIT IN THE NATURE OF MANDAMUS KINDLY BE DIRECT THE RESPONDENTS TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATIONS DATED 15.05.2024 TO RESPONDENT NO.1 VIDE ANNEXURES D AND D1, RESPONDENT NO.2 VIDE ANNEXURE-E AND E1, RESPONDENT NO.3 VIDE ANNEXURE-F AND F1, RESPONDENT NO.4 VIDE ANNEXURE-G, RESPONDENT NO.5 VIDE ANNEXURE-H AND H1,
RESPONDENT NO.6 VIDE ANNEXURE-J AND J1 AND RESPONDENT NO.7 VIDE ANNEXURE-K, AND DIRECT THE RESPONDENTS TO ISSUE FINAL NOTIFICATION U/S 19 OF THE ACT, 2013 AND PASS AN AWARD AND PAY THE COMPENSATION WITHIN ONE MONTH TO THE PETITIONERS AND PASS AN AWARD AND PAY THE COMPENSATION IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY AND ETC.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING

,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned HCGP for respondents No.1 to 4, 6 and 7 and learned counsel for respondent No.5.
2.

The petitioners are aggrieved by a common cause of action as their lands were acquired for the purpose of Upper Krishna project due to the submergence of the land into backwaters of Alamatti dam and due to raise in its height.

Respondent No.6 issued a preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Acquisition Rehabilitation Resettlement Act (hereinafter referred to as 'Act of 2013' for brevity) for NC: 2024:KHC-D:7695 acquisition.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Acquisition Rehabilitation Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The details of the lands to the extent and the date of acquisition along with the names are produced in the tabular column at paragraph No.4 in the petition.
Despite the process of issuance of notification under Section 11 of the Act of 2013, the final notification has not been issued by the respondent - authorities.
Hence, petitioners are before this Court seeking a writ of mandamus for a direction to the respondents to issue final notification as the lands have been utilized by the beneficiary.
4. Learned HCGP representing the state and Counsel for respondent No.5 - beneficiary do not object to the issuance of a preliminary notification and the lands being utilized by respondent No.5.

Therefore, in view of submergence of lands of the petitioners and issuance of the preliminary notification, nothing further remains except for the statutory authorities/state to issue final notification of acquisition and pass suitable orders in accordance with law and thereafter disburse the compensation in favour of the petitioners without much delay as the petitioners have already lost their lands which are submerged.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) Writ petition is allowed.
(ii) Writ of mandamus is issued to respondents No.4, 6 and 7 to pass suitable orders of acquisition of the lands belonging to the petitioners as stated in this petition under Section 19.

(iii) Consider the representations produced at Annexure-D, E, F, G, H, J and K and pass suitable orders in accordance with law, within an outer limit of four weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Sd/-
